mechanism_glossary.DISCONNECTED: it was built, and nothing ever calls it
mechanism_glossary.MISSING GUARD: a case nobody handled — zero, negative, already-cancelled
mechanism_glossary.CONTRACT DRIFT: two halves of the system stopped agreeing on a rule
mechanism_glossary.NEVER RAN: the check exists and has never actually executed
mechanism_glossary.WRONG VALUE: wired correctly, computes the wrong number
mechanism_glossary.WRONG SCOPE: the screen shows too much or too little
mechanism_glossary.DATA STATE: correct on small data, wrong at real production size

surface_glossary.read-path: the screens that read and display data
surface_glossary.write-path: the steps that save or change data
surface_glossary.schema: the shape of the stored data itself
surface_glossary.ci-gate: the automatic checks that run before code ships
surface_glossary.ui-route: a page or screen in the app
surface_glossary.scheduled-job: work that is supposed to run on a timer
surface_glossary.external-integration: a connection to another company's system
surface_glossary.scale: behaviour once there is a lot of real data
